frequency_question: What proportion of historical quarters with similar underlying structural friction report initial GDP growth below 1.5%?
membership_rule: Includes all U.S. quarterly real GDP initial estimates from Q1 1980 to Q4 2024 where baseline output growth hovered in the low-growth band (0.5% to 2.0%). Excludes quarters featuring major exogenous shocks like pandemics or severe energy embargoes.
provenance_note: claimed 4 hits but 5 of 10 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 10 named cases representing balanced economic regimes; total population of similar baseline quarters in this window is approximately 42.
known_gaps: Excludes extreme crisis quarters to isolate structural rather than catastrophic friction.
skeleton: Ten representative low-to-moderate growth quarters sampled across diverse structural regimes since 1980.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 10 sampled baseline quarters resulting in initial sub-1.5% prints.
validity_reason: Structural economic parameters and BEA data collection methodologies remain stable over medium-term horizons.
